title: Out-of-sample check: the calibrated twin's drug knobs against the ToxCast acute MEA positive controls (SIMULATED twin, REAL wells)
status: registered before any statistic of a positive-control or vehicle well's response (rval) was computed or viewed, and before the twin was run for this check
origin: the twin was calibrated on Kapucu/Axion baselines and its knobs were checked in HD13 against Kapucu and ScreenNeuroPharm pairs; ToxCast's rat cortical positive controls are a third laboratory's wells the twin has never seen
seen_before_registration: positive-control well counts for acid 2447 (Bicuculline 349 wells at 25, Picrotoxin 80 at 25, Tetrodotoxin 74 at 1; concentrations in the dump's units, uM) and that they span 97 dates; no rval of any well

HD13 (twin_hd13_perturbation, seed 0, 40 s, same baseline noise): GABA-A block (gabaa_scale 0.2) moved mfr +2.706, burst rate -0.003, pct spikes in bursts +0.278, network burst rate -0.1, synchrony +0.267, isi_cv +1.763 log2; sodium block (threshold_scale 1.6) moved mfr -3.672 and floored the burst and synchrony features
HD13's real references: bicuculline from 60-electrode MCS chambers, where real firing rate fell while the twin's rose (the twin_prior registration's note)
general literature knowledge that GABA-A antagonists increase bursting and synchrony in cortical cultures and that TTX abolishes spiking

Bicuculline.reason: GABA-A antagonist; 25 uM is far above its IC50, so the strong block HD13 used

Picrotoxin.reason: GABA-A channel blocker; the twin has one inhibition knob, so the same prediction as bicuculline

Tetrodotoxin.reason: sodium-channel block, the twin's excitability knob as in HD13

no_knob: none of the three lacks a knob; the twin has no separate knob for a channel blocker versus a competitive antagonist, so picrotoxin and bicuculline share one prediction

synchrony_index.note: different algorithms (STTC vs Axion's); direction only

not_mapped: network_burst_rate_per_min vs network_burst_percentage (related, not the same quantity, schema/FEATURE_SET.md); isi_cv, active_electrodes (no acute counterpart); interburst interval, cross-correlation, the std components and per-network-burst components (no twin counterpart)

twin.model: the calibrated twin (twin.calibrate.calibrated_params) through twin.perturbation._features_for, the same features/mea.py path as every real recording
twin.design: 8 chips, build seeds 9101-9108; each chip simulated untreated (noise seed build + 100000) and under each knob (noise seed build + 200000), 40 s; change = models.dataset.log_ratio(treated, untreated) per feature, floored at log2(0.05)
twin.direction_rule: per knob and feature, the median change over chips; a direction is predicted when |median| >= 0.1 log2 and at least 7 of 8 chips with a defined change share its sign, and at least 5 chips have a defined change; otherwise 'none' and the cell is not scored
twin.commit_rule: the predictions are computed by neuromps.models.twin_toxcast_check --predict and committed (outputs/twin/toxcast_positive_controls_predictions_simulated.json) before the real positive-control statistics are computed

real.x: log2(max(1 + rval/100, 0.05)) per well, NaN dropped
real.effect_per_well: x of the positive-control well minus the median x of the vehicle wells (wllt 'n') of the same component and date; wells on a date without vehicle wells are dropped
real.effect: median over wells, per drug and component
real.interval: 95% percentile interval by bootstrap over dates (2,000 resamples, seed 20261028)
real.established: the interval excludes zero and at least 10 wells have a defined value

agreement: a cell (drug, feature) is scored when the twin predicts a direction and the real direction is established; it agrees when the signs match

P1_bicuculline.statement: the GABA-A block knob moves the shared features the way bicuculline does
P1_bicuculline.test: agreeing / scored >= 2/3, with at least 3 cells scored

P2_picrotoxin.statement: the GABA-A block knob moves the shared features the way picrotoxin does
P2_picrotoxin.test: agreeing / scored >= 2/3, with at least 3 cells scored

P3_tetrodotoxin.statement: the sodium-block knob moves the shared features the way TTX does
P3_tetrodotoxin.test: agreeing / scored >= 2/3, with at least 3 cells scored

P4_firing_rate.statement: the twin gets the firing-rate direction right for every drug where it is scored

magnitude.M1_drug_rank_on_firing_rate: descriptive: whether |change in firing rate| is larger under the sodium-block knob than under the GABA-A knob in the twin, and larger for TTX than for bicuculline (and picrotoxin) in the real wells
magnitude.M2_feature_rank_within_drug: descriptive: Spearman correlation of |twin change| and |real change| over the scored features of each drug; no pass threshold, because HD8 showed magnitudes do not transfer across platforms

reporting: every cell with both values, every prediction with pass/fail, whichever way it falls.
